title: Courgette, baked and preserved in oil
preamble:
Ingredients:-
1
large courgette
Salt

1
large courgette
Salt

Method:-
Slice the courgette into 8mm rounds.
Cover the rounds in salt.
Leave for 30 minutes.
Wash the salt off the rounds.
Dry the rounds.
Preheat the oven to Gas Mark 4
Coat the rounds in olive oil.
Place in oven for 30 minutes.
